profile.headline: Mainframe Development
profile.summary:
Information technology professional with several years of experience analyzing and developing business software applications. I have experience in all phases of the application development life cycle (SDLC) including project planning, functional requirement gathering, technical specification design, systems development, test plan development, testing, training, implementation, production support, and general maintenance.  I also have experience with Agile Scrum methodology project management.

OPERATING SYSTEMS
 MVS, VSE, OS/399, OS/2, Z/OS, Windows XP, Windows 10

PROGRAMMING LANGUAGES
JCL, COBOL, CICS, SQL, Easytrieve, SAS, Crystal Reports, FOCUS

ON-LINE SYSTEMS
CICS, IMS DC, MICRO FOCUS 

UTILITIES/TOOLS
TSO, ISPF, Micro Focus, Component Manager, XPEDITER, SPUFI, QMF, FILEAID, CHANGEMAN, PLATINUM, File Manager

Databases
IMS, DB2, VSAM, TPFILES, Microsoft Access, ORACLE. 

JOB SCHEDULING
Jobtrac, Endeavor, CA-7, ChangeMan, Control-M

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description:
• Developed Technical Designs for the Batch COBOL BAI file extract enhancements.
• Analyzed, developed and tested Mainframe COBOL applications for the Electronic Windows System.
• Developed, maintained, and designed models based on new requirements documents.
• Participated in requirements, design, and code peer reviews.

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description:
•	Analyzed, developed and tested Micro Focus and Mainframe COBOL applications for the
 LifePro Insurance System.
•	Prepared estimates for assigned development tasks and estimates for upcoming task order 
 work based on new proposals and/or statements of work.
•	Developed, maintained, and designed models based on new/updated requirements documents.
•	Participated in requirements, design, and code peer reviews.
•	Research on complex problems, do analysis, debug and provide efficient and accurate solutions 
 in timely manner.

company.name: Transamerica Agency Network, Inc.( Contractor Through TEKsystems)

positions.title: IT Specialist
positions.description:
•	Analyzed, developed and tested MVS Mainframe applications for various client systems 
 including retail, finance, and government. 
•	Analyzed Client Business Environments
 Determined requirements for test environments
 	 Designed and build test environments
•	Managed environment data load and refreshes. 
•	Took part in meeting with client, gather requirement, prepare functional specification, technical 
 specification, approach document. 
•	Researched on complex problems, analysis, debugging and provided efficient and accurate 
 solutions in timely manner. 
•	Aligned and maintained correct version of code at the time of check out and program modification. 
•	As a lead developer, designed algorithm, code critical and complex requirements, prepared
 proper documentation.
•	Prepared Unit test cases, regression test cases and perform unit testing, regression testing in 
 both test and integration environment.
•	Maintenance and tuning of performance of existing system’s COBOL, JCL, CICS online screens 
 and DB2 database system. 
•	Give oncall support for mainframe batch cycle and online CICS screen issues.
•	Done elevation of fully tested code to test and production region, take part in release elevation, 
 monitor batch cycle performance.
•	Work on different production work-orders and provide solution to client in quick turn around 
 time. 
•	Prepared documents and design using Microsoft word, Microsoft Excel.
•	Used Microsoft outlook and Lotus Notes for email communication.
•	Used sort utility to format various reports and extracts.
•	Used XPEDITER to debug COBOL-DB2-CICS program.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained complex, mission-critical applications as defined by 
requirements.
• Prepared estimates for assigned development tasks and estimates for upcoming 
task order work based on new proposals and/or statements of work.
• Developed, maintained, and designed models based on new/updated requirements 
documents.
• Proficiently applied appropriate methodologies to design, code, and test, to 
implement and maintain systems.
• Prepared, wrote, reviewed and maintained system documentation. 
• Participated in requirements, design, and code peer reviews.
• Created and executed unit test cases.
• Supported system and customer acceptance testing.

positions.title: IT Lead Analyst
positions.description:
Primary responsibilities included analysis, design, development, and implementation of software for the CIS (billing) group.
Completed analysis and specified requirements for medium to large systems.
Designed medium to large business systems.
Developed application programs according to the specifications defined by the project team.
Tested and Implemented Billing system applications.

Mainframe, COBOL, ORACLE, CICS, TSO/ISPF, JCL, PL/SQL, SQL Stored Procedures

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Primary responsibilities included analysis, design, development, and implementation of software for the Billing area. This included conversion of newly acquired companies, writing system and program specifications, setting up test cases, develop requirements and work closely with the business unit. 
Assumed technical lead roles in various projects such as Oracle and OS/390 / z/OS upgrades. 
Converted several Acquired telephone companies from Cart/Tape media to FTP for data transmission to and from TDS. 
Wrote programming specifications, including output requirements and flow charts. 
Analyzed system requirements, including identifying program interactions and appropriate interfaces with affected components and sub systems. 
Designed and conducted training sessions for users. 

Mainframe, COBOL, SQL, ORACLE, CICS, FOCUS, FILE-AID, TSO/ISPF, JCL
